mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix removes the closed-world definition of the allowed set; injecting a violation that adds Customer->PostDecision to the allowed set directly contradicts the LeastPrivilege and FR_015_StaffOnlyDecisions assertions, which check that customers cannot record decisions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { Customer -> PostDecision in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OnePendingPerCustomer removes the constraint that prevents two PendingReview applications from sharing the same owner. Injecting two distinct applications in PendingReview with the same owner forces the FR_005 assertion to find a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OnePendingViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.owner = a2.owner and a1.status = PendingReview and a2.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditSubmitEvent allows a LoanApplication to exist with no EvSubmitted audit event. Injecting an application that has no corresponding submission event forces the AuditCompleteness and FR_016_AuditTrail assertions to fail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingSubmitEvent { some a: LoanApplication | no e: ApplicationEvent | e.forApplication = a and e.eventType = EvSubmitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DecisionByStaff allows a Customer-role User to appear as decidedBy on a Decision. Injecting such a Decision forces FR_015_StaffOnlyDecisions and AttributionCorrectness to fail because they assert all decisions are made by BankStaff.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CustomerDecisionViolation { some d: Decision | d.decidedBy.role = Customer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_DecisionInjectivity removes the constraint that a Decision object can belong to at most one LoanApplication. Injecting two distinct applications that share the same Decision atom simulates the dual-decision scenario that FR-012 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SharedDecisionViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | some d: Decision | a1.decision = d and a2.decision = d }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditSubmitActorIsOwner allows a EvSubmitted event to be attributed to a User who is not the application's owner. Injecting such a misattribution directly violates AttributionCorrectness and FR_013_CustomerSeesOwnOnly, which assert the submit-event actor is always the owning customer.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedSubmit { some e: ApplicationEvent | e.eventType = EvSubmitted and e.actor != e.forApplication.owner }
